description:
The Relation Grid GROUP (RFC 0050 · Episode 2, the federation re-read):
        an ordered list of tables, each an ordinary RelGrid that does not know
        it is in one, stacked down one column of boxes with a FENCE between
        every two and around the ends — a slot the group mints and the domain
        fills. Members are identities; the group's own state is which show, in
        what order, and (later) which are folded. Everything inside a member —
        its cursor, its selection, its copy, its handover, the domain its ask
        reaches — is the member's own and untouched.

        What the group shares is the one thing separate tables cannot agree
        on by themselves: column geometry. It is the single writer of widths
        — it hears any member's resize report, applies it to the siblings
        through their public verbs, and reports once — and it reaches into no
        member's layout to do it.

        A module of its own because the guarantee is structural: this module
        depends on the grid, and the grid's does not depend on this one. Not
        one line of group code lives in the table.
